children: Dollarama is pulling off a rare feat in Canadian retail these days: gaining market share. Martin Landry of Stifel notes that traffic is up 3.7% year-over-year, and something that hasn't been a common theme in Canada, "especially with population growth slowing." At the same time, the company is generating strong profit margins in Canada, despite rising freight and logistics costs. Landry says that the market share gains are driven by Dollarama's deep value offering at a time when Canadian shoppers are looking for affordable options for everyday essentials, while stable EBITDA margins reflect a flexible merchandising assortment. "It is difficult to find another Canadian retailer with such a predictable growth and profitability profile," Landry says. (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
